item.name: Sanitizer_Test_Strips
item.description: Hydrion QT-10 quaternary sanitizer test paper, 0–400 ppm.
item.readyBeforeUse: Dry, unexpired strips remain and the color chart is readable.
item.readyForNextPerson: The container is closed, dry, and contains unexpired strips.
item.ifNotReady: Do not estimate sanitizer strength. Ask the Food Lead for compatible test strips.
